detail.longDescription: Fast, private, fully-featured, built in Rust (forked Wry, system's WebView). 40 MB. Not a Chromium fork. Native adblocking (forked adblock-rust), major Chrome extension support, deeply integrated productivity tools, a custom agentic browsing engine, and a lot more. It's not just another wrapper built in a few days. And... Work mode: a shared environment where you and AI agents can browse, research, build, and get real work done together. Live browser sessions, parallel sub-agents, tools, files, components, and interactive results, all in one canvas. AI is optional (disable in one click). No telemetry. BYOK support and local models. Website: https://zephium.app Launch video: https://youtu.be/QbSarcWspvw X: https://x.com/CryntaDev
